overflow: all|peek|page

example: {"c":"Timeline","style":"history","items":[{"time":"Mon","title":"Watered fern","meta":"Bathroom · Ledge","done":true},{"time":"Wed","title":"Repotted basil","meta":"Kitchen","done":true}]}
